_readme: AI text prompts (sent to Perchance's ai-text-plugin). The game fills in the {placeholders} and sends the result as the instruction.
{other} / {otherDesc}: the second lady in scenes with two of them (shared). guidance is inserted wherever {guidance} appears: tone, length, how descriptive, etc.

Which prompt is used where: scene (client highlights), private (private time), train, proposition (date invitations), encounter (visits, lovers waiting), reckless, breakup, backstory, and one per shared scene type in bonds.json (shared, shared_rivals, shared_friend, shared_lesson, shared_bath). Add a shared scene with its own 'ai' key and add a matching prompt here.
scene: Write a short scene (about 120 words, third person, past tense) for a fantasy isekai pleasure-house game. {name} is a {race} working at {house}: {appearance}. She is wearing {clothing}. Personality: {personality}. Her client: {client}. Service: {service}, which is {stance}. Setting: {setting}. {guidance} All characters are consenting adults. Output only the scene.
